We need to decide how much to fill. Probably fill to full capacity. So we need to calculate how many gallons to add to reach 50 gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We only know liters. But maybe we just fill to full capacity. So call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36. But we might want to round. Let's use 47.36 gallons.
